name: GET /api/auth/sso/providers - list enabled SSO providers
description: Public. Returns the identity providers the sign-in page should offer ({id, name}); a provider is listed only when its client id and secret are configured, so the list is empty in environments without SSO. Covers: a user can sign in with Google or Microsoft SSO (which buttons appear).

errorCases.when: unexpected server fault; the handler only reads startup configuration and has no request-dependent failure
errorCases.notReproducibleReason: No request input reaches this handler, so no request can make it fail.
